histology: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC); PurIST RNA signature classifies the tumor as the basal-like transcriptional subtype
stage: IV (metastatic): large primary pancreatic mass with multiple liver metastases each >1 cm

biomarkers.name: KRAS G12D
biomarkers.decision_resolution: ctDNA NGS call; tissue NGS confirmation strengthens eligibility for KRAS G12D-selective and pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor trials. Gates daraxonrasib (RMC-6236, pan-RAS), RMC-9805 (KRAS G12D-selective), MRTX1133, and KRAS-directed vaccine/T-cell programs.

biomarkers.name: MLH1 mutation
biomarkers.value: somatic mutation reported (single MMR-gene variant; tumor is microsatellite stable and germline-negative)
biomarkers.method: Tempus xF (plasma ctDNA); germline-negative on Tempus xG
biomarkers.decision_resolution: MMR protein IHC (MLH1/PMS2/MSH2/MSH6) on tumor tissue is the decision-grade test. A single somatic MLH1 variant with MSS status, TMB 8.6 mut/Mb, and no germline finding most likely reflects MMR-proficient biology; pembrolizumab on the dMMR/MSI-H label would require IHC loss or an MSI-H call, neither present here.

biomarkers.name: SMAD4
biomarkers.decision_resolution: NGS truncating-variant call; not a direct therapy gate. SMAD4 loss is a poor-prognosis marker associated with a metastatic-dominant pattern; carried as co-alteration context.

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.decision_resolution: NGS variant calls; informs co-mutation context (near-universal in PDAC), not a direct therapy gate. Relevant to DDR-directed and cell-cycle trial stratification.

biomarkers.name: ARID1A
biomarkers.decision_resolution: NGS frameshift call; ARID1A loss creates candidate synthetic-lethal vulnerabilities (ATR inhibitors, EZH2 inhibitors) explored in early-phase basket trials. Tissue confirmation and, where a trial requires it, ARID1A/BAF IHC strengthen eligibility.

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Below the >=10 mut/Mb threshold for the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab TMB-high label; reinforces low expected benefit from single-agent immune-checkpoint blockade.

biomarkers.name: Microsatellite status
biomarkers.decision_resolution: MSI-high/dMMR is required for tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab; MSS effectively excludes that pathway. Confirm against MMR IHC given the concurrent somatic MLH1 variant.

biomarkers.name: PurIST subtype
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Single-sample RNA classifier; predictive/prognostic context. Basal-like PDAC carries a worse prognosis and has been associated in retrospective series with relatively less benefit from FOLFIRINOX versus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel; informs chemotherapy-backbone discussion with the treating team rather than gating a targeted agent.

biomarkers.name: Germline status
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Germline-negative: no BRCA1/2, PALB2, ATM, or Lynch germline finding. Removes the germline-HRD/PARP-maintenance (olaparib POLO) rationale and argues against germline Lynch as the source of the somatic MLH1 variant.

biomarkers.name: Gene rearrangements
biomarkers.decision_resolution: No fusions/rearrangements: no NRG1, NTRK, ALK, ROS1, RET, FGFR, or BRAF fusion. Forecloses the fusion-directed tumor-agnostic options that are otherwise high-yield in KRAS-wildtype PDAC.

biomarkers.name: HLA type
biomarkers.decision_resolution: HLA class I genotype gates HLA-restricted KRAS-directed immunotherapy. The patient is NOT HLA-C*08:02, so the published HLA-C*08:02-restricted anti-KRAS-G12D TCR-T does not apply. A*02:01 and A*01:01 are common restriction elements relevant to several KRAS-mutant vaccine and TCR programs; match each candidate immunotherapy against the patient's actual alleles before enrollment.

biomarkers.name: Additional xR variants
biomarkers.value: ABCC3 missense; ASXL1 frameshift; BCL7A splice-region; BCLAF1 stop-gain; LRP1B splice-region
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Largely variants of uncertain significance / passengers in PDAC. ASXL1 frameshift detected in plasma should be evaluated for clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) rather than tumor origin (paired blood-cell sequencing). LRP1B loss is a weak correlate of immunotherapy responsiveness but not decision-grade here given MSS and TMB 8.6.

targetable_features.rationale: The lead actionable driver. Direct small-molecule axis: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236, pan-RAS(ON)), RMC-9805 (KRAS G12D(ON)-selective), and MRTX1133 (KRAS G12D), all in early-phase PDAC trials. Immunologic axis: KRAS-mutant vaccines (e.g. ELI-002 amphiphile targeting G12D and other alleles) and adoptive T-cell/TCR programs directed at KRAS G12D. This is the highest-yield molecularly targeted feature in the case.

targetable_features.feature: HLA-restricted KRAS-directed immunotherapy (HLA class I genotype A*01:01, A*02:01, B*37:01, B*44:02, C*05:01, C*06:02)
targetable_features.rationale: The HLA genotype determines which KRAS G12D vaccine/TCR/cell-therapy products can present the mutant epitope. Decision-relevant negative: the patient is not HLA-C*08:02, so the published C*08:02-restricted anti-KRAS-G12D TCR-T is not an option. A*02:01- and A*01:01-restricted KRAS programs should be screened against these alleles. Pairing KRAS G12D with the patient's actual HLA is what makes the immunotherapy axis concrete rather than generic.

ARID1A (SWI/SNF subunit) loss-of-function creates candidate synthetic-lethal dependencies on ATR and on EZH2, explored in early-phase basket trials enrolling ARID1A-deficient solid tumors. A secondary but genuinely targetable axis distinct from the KRAS driver.

targetable_features.feature: MLH1 mutation / mismatch-repair status (in an MSS, TMB-8.6, germline-negative context)
targetable_features.rationale: Decision-relevant feature requiring validation, not a confirmed actionable target. A single somatic MLH1 variant alongside MSS status and TMB below 10 mut/Mb most likely reflects MMR-proficient biology, which makes checkpoint-inhibitor monotherapy low-yield. MMR protein IHC on tissue is the gating test: dMMR by IHC would open pembrolizumab, while retained expression confirms the immunotherapy axis is not indicated on the tumor-agnostic label.

targetable_features.feature: MSS status with TMB 8.6 mut/Mb (decision-relevant negative immunotherapy findings)
targetable_features.rationale: Microsatellite stability plus sub-threshold TMB jointly argue against single-agent immune-checkpoint blockade on the tumor-agnostic labels. Carried so downstream agents treat checkpoint monotherapy as low-yield and route immunotherapy thinking toward KRAS-directed vaccines/T-cell therapy or combination trials rather than off-label PD-1 monotherapy.

targetable_features.feature: SMAD4 E520* loss and TP53 (Y126S, A138V) co-mutations
targetable_features.rationale: Co-alteration context rather than direct drug targets. SMAD4 loss is a poor-prognosis, metastasis-associated marker; TP53 inactivation is near-universal in PDAC and informs DDR-directed and cell-cycle trial stratification. Carried so the board weighs prognosis and combination rationale, not as standalone targetable drivers.

Predictive/prognostic RNA-signature feature. Basal-like PDAC carries a worse prognosis and a debated chemo-backbone signal (relatively less FOLFIRINOX benefit in some retrospective series). Informs the treating team's chemotherapy choice and trial stratification rather than gating a specific targeted agent; carried as context for the board's risk weighting.
